story_sequence.text: `beacon-gen-implement` resolves the owning program/lake topology and blocks target lake `pi-host-ui-ux` when `program-run-state.next_action=beacon-gen-implement:content-hub-foundation`; reason_code `program_next_action_mismatch`; no implementation evidence is written.
When the target feature matches `program-run-state.next_action`, admission continues and records the resolved program slug, lake slug, material path, and next_action source.
A downstream lake with `depends_on` entries is blocked when prerequisite lakes lack implementation closure or QA acceptance evidence; reason_code `program_dependency_unclosed`.
Repos/features without owning program topology keep normal per-feature implement admission behavior and are not blocked by program next_action checks.

QA/implementation evidence rejects required full-parity UI surfaces that are still `coming_soon`, preview-only, static shell, or no-op recovery controls; reason_code `static_shell_implementation_evidence`.
Tests that only grep source strings, route names, labels, or exported constants cannot satisfy runtime/browser/user-behavior AC; reason_code `static_source_assertion_only`.
When implement admission is blocked by AC-028 or AC-030, generated state is diagnostic-only and cannot mark tasks done, write implementation summary, or update acceptance/release evidence.
